name: HTTP Client
description: A Postman-style HTTP workbench: compose requests, send them through a native sidecar, and inspect responses.

contributions.label: HTTP Client
contributions.description: Compose and send HTTP requests, inspect responses, keep collections and environments.

contributions.label: HTTP Client
contributions.description: Create an HTTP Client connection to choose where collections and environments are stored.

fields.label: Connection name
fields.description: Name shown in the connection list.

fields.label: Storage directory
fields.description: Optional. Where collections, environments, history and tabs are stored (store.json). Point it at a mounted volume so the data survives a container rebuild. Click the folder button to pick a local directory, or type an absolute path. Leave empty to use the plugin's default data directory.

zh-CN.name: HTTP 客户端
zh-CN.description: 类似 Postman 的 HTTP 接口调试工作台：构造请求、通过原生 Sidecar 发送并查看响应。

com.jettech.httpclient.workbench.label: HTTP 客户端
com.jettech.httpclient.workbench.description: 构造并发送 HTTP 请求、查看响应，管理集合与环境变量。

com.jettech.httpclient.connection.label: HTTP 客户端
com.jettech.httpclient.connection.description: 新建一个 HTTP 客户端连接，用于指定集合与环境数据的存储目录。

display_name.label: 连接名称
display_name.description: 显示在连接列表中的名称。

storage_dir.label: 数据存储目录
storage_dir.description: 可选。集合、环境、历史与标签页保存在该目录下的 store.json。建议指向挂载卷，这样 Docker 容器重建后数据不会丢失。点击右侧文件夹按钮选择本地目录，或手动填写绝对路径；留空则使用插件默认数据目录。
